channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Netanyahu says he’s ‘going to New York’ to attend UNGA despite Mayor Zohran Mamdani urging authorities to arrest him
item.description: Netanyahu said he intends to use his visit to challenge Mamdani's criticism of Israel and what he described as divisive rhetoric.

item.title: World News Today Live Updates on July 30, 2026 : Telegram founder Pavel Durov charged by Russia over app's alleged role in Ukrainian spy operations
item.description: World News Today Live Updates on July 30, 2026: Stay informed on global events with our in-depth world news coverage, bringing you the latest developments across politics, economy, and culture. Discover insights into international affairs, breaking news, and the trends shaping our interconnected world, all in one place.

item.title: Telegram founder Pavel Durov charged by Russia over app's alleged role in Ukrainian spy operations
item.description: The FSB also said Durov had been placed on an international wanted list, although it did not specify the legal mechanism through which it would seek his arrest.

item.title: Wisconsin brewery that promised free beer the day Trump dies now faces license revocation
item.description: Bangstad, who describes Minocqua Brewing Company as “the state's most progressive brewery,” said he intends to challenge the decision in court and is asking supporters to help fund the legal fight.

item.title: France, Spain Make Progress on Wildfires as Two Die in Greece
item.description: Firefighters are making progress in containing the spread of wildfires in France and Spain, with cooler weather toward the weekend offering the prospect of relief, but two died tackling a blaze in Greece.

item.title: J.P. Nadda reviews readiness for NEET UG 2026 counselling
item.description: The Union health minister also announced a series of tech-driven, student-centric reforms to simplify and speed up undergraduate medical admissions nationwide.

item.title: ₹1 crore package, no money to pay tax: Social media reacts to CA’s post, ‘High income may not mean better savings’
item.description: Many professionals shared stories of clients facing tax payment challenges despite high salaries. Critics of the government highlighted reduced tax exemptions and a lack of financial literacy.

item.title: Meta writes to Centre, vows enhanced checks for PM Modi's posts, other prominent accounts
item.description: The Mark Zuckerberg-led company has written to the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), detailing the enhanced safeguards it has introduced to prevent similar incidents involving posts from the PM and other prominent public figures.

item.title: Delhi-Hyderabad IndiGo flight carrying Revanth Reddy lands safely after rain-triggered go-around: Report
item.description: An IndiGo Delhi-Hyderabad flight reportedly carrying Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy made a safe landing on its second attempt after a go-around triggered by heavy rain and strong winds at Hyderabad airport.

item.title: Rand Paul orders Fauci lawyer removed from Senate hearing, cites rules
item.description: The dramatic moment came during proceedings in which Fauci, the former director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID), invoked his Fifth Amendment right against self-incrimination.

item.title: Meet Zaid Khan, who became a ‘crorepati’ at 22 and is now an IIM Bangalore student
item.description: Zaid Khan encouraged young people to begin earning from their skills, saying that even small transactions can help build confidence.

item.title: CJP spokesperson faces death threats after Jantar Mantar protest: Social media reacts, ‘Punishment for raising voice’
item.description: Ratna Singh reported receiving death threats, sharing her resilience on social media. Despite online abuse, she emphasises her commitment to her work.&nbsp;

item.title: Minister Goyal says India-US trade deal can move ahead once tariff edge is secured
item.description: Piyush Goyal said the first tranche of the bilateral trade agreement is finalized, but implementation depends on Washington ensuring Indian exporters retain a competitive position against rival economies.

item.title: Iran denounces US-Saudi strikes in Iraq after CENTCOM targets IRGC-linked sites: ‘Criminal, inhumane, provocative’
item.description: In a statement, Iran's Ministry of Foreign Affairs said the attacks targeted areas in Iraq, including facilities and locations belonging to official Iraqi institutions as well as processions and stations linked to Arbaeen pilgrims.

item.title: India targets 100 crore 5G users by 2030, Jyotiraditya Scindia says; eyes global lead in 6G
item.description: India aims to connect 100 crore people to 5G by 2030, Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia says, as IMC 2026 focuses on AI, 6G, digital public infrastructure and next-generation connectivity.

item.title: ‘This crosses a line’: FIFA faces backlash over selling World Cup stake, Donald Trump connection
item.description: FIFA's proposal to sell a minority stake in World Cup commercial rights faces backlash from governing bodies and fans, fearing excessive commercialisation and ties to Trump.&nbsp;

item.title: IMD warns of flash flood risk across central India as monsoon intensifies
item.description: The weather office has warned of a low to moderate flash flood risk in parts of Chhattisgarh, east Madhya Pradesh, Vidarbha and Odisha over the next 24 hours, with widespread rainfall expected across northwest and central India in the coming days.

item.title: Anthony Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment, refuses to answer questions in Republican-led Senate hearing on COVID-19 response
item.description: Republican lawmakers continue to scrutinize his role in the nation's COVID-19 response and accuse him of misleading Congress about research linked to the virus's origins—allegations he has repeatedly denied.

item.title: Trump vows to hit Iran 'hard' after 'surprise' attack on US bases in Jordan: 'We are going to beat...'
item.description: Donald Trump said American troops had only a few minutes to intercept the incoming missiles and added that he had personally reviewed footage of the operation.

item.title: Bihar man claims he was booked in NEET protest case despite being in Russia for 4 months
item.description: Kishanganj Superintendent of Police Hari Mohan Shukla neither confirmed nor denied whether a person matching the claims made in the viral video had been booked.

item.title: CJP claps back at JP Nadda’s comments on student activists: Social media reacts, ‘Is this undeclared Emergency?’
item.description: JP Nadda downplayed arrests of student protesters, reflecting on his own experiences as a student leader during the Emergency. CJP spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka hit back.

item.title: Trump blasts Fauci, says he ‘always tried to protect China’ during COVID-19 pandemic
item.description: In a post on Truth Social, Trump defended his administration's pandemic response and blamed former President Joe Biden for restoring Fauci's influence after he left office.

item.title: India among regions at highest risk as Strait of Hormuz closure threatens global marine biodiversity
item.description: As the US-Iran conflict causes shipping disruptions, the IMO emphasises the danger of biofouling on stranded vessels. Scientists warn that this could lead to invasive species spreading globally, highlighting the urgent need for cleaning protocols and monitoring measures.

item.title: Yemen government accuses Houthis of planning Red Sea transit fee system under Iranian guidance
item.description: Information Minister Moammar al-Eryani said &nbsp;that recently obtained intelligence indicated Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps was helping the Houthis create a technical and administrative framework to collect payments from shipping companies using one of the world's busiest maritime corridors.

item.title: Govt proposes court nod for birth, death registration after 2-year delay
item.description: The Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Bill, 2026 was introduced by minister of state for home affairs Nityanand Rai, as the government seeks to strengthen India's civil registration system, encourage timely reporting of vital events, improve data integrity, and prevent misuse and fraud.

item.title: Elon Musk’s xAI challenges Minnesota law targeting AI ‘nudify’ apps
item.description: The legislation, which takes effect on Saturday, targets websites and applications that enable users to create non-consensual sexually explicit AI-generated images

item.title: 'India, China... main culprits': US Senator backs bill proposing up to 100% tariffs on buyers of Russian oil
item.description: The US Senate has overwhelmingly backed a bipartisan effort to fast-track a bill authorising President Donald Trump to impose sanctions on major importers of Russian and Iranian oil, with India and China among those likely to be affected.

item.title: Lok Sabha passes stricter anti-paper leak bill after NEET uproar
item.description: For service providers involved in examination malpractices, the maximum fine has been raised from ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore. Directors, senior management and persons in charge of such service providers will face imprisonment ranging from five to ten years instead of the existing three to ten years.

item.title: India's public grievance backlog swells despite record complaint disposal
item.description: States and Union territories disposed of a record number of public grievances in June, but an even faster rise in fresh complaints pushed pending cases on the Centre's CPGRAMS portal to more than 216,000.

item.title: Viral video: Parents save ₹50 lakh for wedding; daughter says it’s bad idea, ‘Imagine if they had invested that money…’
item.description: Digital creator Pranati critiques the tradition of saving for daughters' weddings, advocating instead for financial investments.&nbsp;

item.title: Late birth and death registration to require judicial orders: New Bill proposes two-tier system
item.description: The Registration of Births and Deaths Amendment Bill, 2026, aims to tighten regulations for delayed registrations. It proposes a two-tier system, retaining current processes for delays of 1-2 years while enforcing stricter norms for those exceeding 2 years, requiring judicial approval.

item.title: Japan's quake shakes Kumamoto, the city anchoring TSMC's ₹1.91 lakh crore expansion
item.description: A temporary shutdown at a factory in one Japanese prefecture attracts worldwide attention because Kumamoto has emerged as one of Japan's most important semiconductor manufacturing hubs.

item.title: Delhi: FSSAI suspends Park Plaza Hotel licence over hygiene lapses, expired food products
item.description: During an inspection, the food safety regulator found that the hotel was using heavily deteriorated, darkened cooking oil for frying, making it unsafe for human consumption

item.title: Not eligible for Ayushman Bharat card? West Bengal announces new health insurance scheme: Check if you can apply
item.description: The Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana has been announced in West Bengal to replace Swasthya Sathi, providing ₹5 lakh cashless coverage for those not eligible for Ayushman Bharat.&nbsp;

item.title: Assam Floods: CM Himanta Biswa Sarma steps up relief efforts as 7 new fatalities push death toll to 75
item.description: As flood misery continues in Assam and rescue operations go on, the state government has increased ex gratia relief. As many as 32,000 displaced people are currently sheltered across newly established relief camps.
